sentence_stem: My new bicycle is much faster than
full_sentence: My new bicycle is much faster than my old one.
acceptable_variants: the one I rode last year.

options.text: my old one was very fast.
options.why_wrong: After 'than' the clause must name the item being compared; this starts a new sentence about the old bicycle's speed instead.

options.text: the oldest one in the shop.
options.why_wrong: 'Oldest' is a superlative, which does not fit a comparison with 'than'; a comparison between two items needs a comparative.

options.text: as fast as my old one.
options.why_wrong: 'As fast as' shows equality, but the stem says the new bicycle is much faster.

explanation: The comparative 'faster' needs 'than' followed by the item it is compared with. Short adjectives take the -er form, and the completion must name the second item.
translation: Мій новий велосипед набагато швидший, ніж мій старий.
